textSegments: Complies with latest ATX 12V V2.3 Standard for utmost reliability and compatibility
- Complies with latest ATX 12V V2.3 Standard for utmost reliability and compatibility
- High current single +12V rail for best compatibility.
- Ultra-quiet 120mm cooling fan delivers excellent airflow.
- Extra long EPS/ATX 12V 4+4pin CPU cable support full tower chassis.
- Built-in industry grade protections: Over Voltage, Over Power and Short-Circuit protection
- Safety / EMI Approvals: TUV, CE, GOST
The +3.3V & +5V & +12V combined output power shall not exceed 385W.

Short Circuit Protection: An output short circuit is defined as any output impedance of less than 0.1 ohms. The power supply shall shut down and latch off for shorting the +3.3 VDC, +5 VDC, +12 VDC rails to return or any other rail.
Over Power Protection: The power supply shall be shut down and latch off, if the wattage of the power supply is higher from 130% to 160%。
“Power Good” signal rise time is within 1ms.
The power supply with 80% of Max. load at 230 Vac, 50 Hz should supply regulated
DC outputs for at least 16 ms after the loss of the AC input voltage at zero cross.
70% typical at nominal line, maximum load.
